content: FORMAT-DIVERGENCE ADDENDUM 2026-05-21: second data point confirming the original finding (recorded earlier same session under format-divergence,convergence-test-empirical-finding,methodology-finding tags). PARENT FINDING summary: in prompt_source_tokens admission record exchange, ChatGPT specified granular per-test verdict structure; Claude conveyed spirit but not letter to Gemini; Gemini given format freedom defaulted to its own preferred blended-narrative format in v2. SECOND DATA POINT: in chronicle_failure_profile v1, Gemini reorganized the canonical eight-element capture surface (raw source, byte/token range, tokenizer, normalization rules, source hash, run id/timestamp, producer node, exclusions) into a non-canonical eight that collapsed three normalization sub-rules into separate elements while burying or omitting raw-source/byte-range/tokenizer/source-hash from the enumeration. When the gap was named explicitly in the v2 prompt with canonical structure quoted verbatim, Gemini self-corrected cleanly in v2: Section 2 titled 'Complete Capture Surface (Canonical Eight Elements)' with explicit one-to-one mapping back to the prompt_source_tokens v3 framework. KEY REFINEMENT TO THE PARENT FINDING: format drift recurs when canonical structure is not explicitly enforced in the prompt, but is correctable in a single round when named with the exact structure quoted. The pattern is TRACTABLE, not permanent. Practical implication: prompts to model nodes must include canonical structure verbatim in any round where structural fidelity matters; the spirit-not-letter shortcut fails reliably. GUARDRAIL CARRIED FROM CHATGPT (2026-05-21): this is evidence, not proof. Do not overgeneralize from one Gemini exchange. The methodology claim is narrower: concrete artifact pressure exposed format-level divergence that continued conceptual refinement had not surfaced, and explicit canonical-structure enforcement closed it in one round. Single model family (Gemini 3.5 Flash via Google), single exchange, two vectors. Replication across model families and additional vectors required before generalization. Updated confidence reflects two data points but remains hypothesis layer.
